new_descriptive_target.aggregation: equal per-event within physical site x season x year; then equal across present years within physical site x season; then equal physical sites within season

bootstrap.unit: original entire physical Primary.Site.ID, not camera device, observation, individual unknown, season-year or taxon
bootstrap.weights: iid Exponential(1) site multipliers shared across both seasons and all original four score contrasts
bootstrap.estimator: ratio of weighted site seasonal means
bootstrap.site_set: All original heldout scored sites, sorted and indexed; no matching subset selection

hard_stops: Any source MD5, source v2 schema, original scored count or unique physical site count mismatch
Original winter/summer mean or 0.05 lower site-bootstrap bound differs from original by > 1e-10
Missing component score or nonfinite adjusted score
Any use of site/taxon matched post-outcome subset instead of full original heldout population
Any changing 2000 bootstrap draws/seed or percentile bounds after seeing adjusted contrast
Any declaration that these intervals independently confirm the seasonal clock mechanism
claim_limits: Post-outcome exploratory interval, not pre-specified inference
No guarantee of independent spatial sampling and bootstrap coverage
No camera hour-level operational effort denominator or independent clock calibration
No causal sunlight response or animal individual-level tracking
Original primary solar advantage both seasons is NOT SUPPORTED
Original ODSP qualified routes and terminal results remain untouched
